title: Sharp Non-Asymptotic Quantum Query Lower Bounds for k-Sum and Element Distinctness via Exact Tensor-Projector Adversary Duals and Stirling Spectral Multiplicities
abstract: We establish explicit, zero-O(.) non-asymptotic quantum query lower bounds for k-Sum over any finite abelian group G of order q and for Element Distinctness, backed by constructive Lean 4.36.0 formalization and zero-float rational LDL^T matrix certificates. First, for every k >= 1 and single-subset tensor projector H_S(alpha) = sum_{T subseteq S} alpha_{|T|} E_T (alpha_0 = 1, alpha_k = 0), we prove the exact minimax query-difference identity ||H_S(alpha) o Delta_i||_op = ((q-1)/q) max_j |alpha_j - alpha_{j+1}| >= (q-1)/(qk), establish that the witness-hyperplane Gram operator H_S P_{E_S} H_S^T = (H_S Pi_{E_S})(H_S Pi_{E_S})^T (for H_S = I_{q^k} - E_1^{otimes k}, P_{E_S} = Pi_{E_S} Pi_{E_S}^T) has exact nonzero eigenvalues m/q (1 <= m <= min(k, q)) with Stirling multiplicities S_2(k, m) prod_{j=1}^{m-1}(q - j) (yielding ||H_S P_{E_S} H_S^T||_op = min(k, q)/q identically for both k-Sum and Element Distinctness, equaling k/q whenever q >= k), and prove that (H_S(lin) o Delta_i) Pi_{E_S} is an exact scaled isometry of squared norm (q-1)/(q^2 k^2) while ||(H_S o Delta_i) Pi_{E_S}||_op^2 <= (q-1)/q^2 with exact trace (q-1)^k/q^2. Second, combining the truncated-ramp block adversary Gamma_S = (H_S otimes B_S^{(d)}) (Pi_{E_S} otimes I) with Bonferroni unique-solution counting (q >= (4k+1) C(n,k), rho = C(n,k)/q) cancels q completely and yields an explicit non-asymptotic adversary lower bound with certified constants c_2 > 0.428 (n^{2/3}), c_3 > 0.341 (n^{3/4}), and c_4 > 0.299 (n^{4/5}). Third, for every total Boolean function f : G^n -> {0,1}, we give a self-contained proof of the positive-weight certificate barrier ADV^+(f) <= sqrt(C_0(f) C_1(f)) <= sqrt(C_1(f) n), prove exact tightness ADV^+(TH_k^n) = sqrt(k(n-k+1)) on k-Threshold, and certify exact finite-n crossovers where the negative-weight bound strictly pierces sqrt(kn). Twenty constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), 16 zero-float Python certificates, and 56 adversarial tests accompany the manuscript.
keywords: Stirling numbers of the second kind
